summary: Hunter stranded in a significant winter storm in a remote area of the Flat Tops Wilderness; tent buried in snow, low on food, wet and cold; GCSAR paged RCSAR for mutual aid; ATV approach then snowshoe to the hunter; provided food/water and walked out to staging (14+ hour mission)
responding_agency: Garfield County SAR + Routt County SAR
notes: run 695: parent-opened Far Routt Newsletter Winter Edition Jan-2025 (Q4 mission summary, date 2024-10-30); RCSAR assisting GCSAR; severe weather/terrain/darkness slowed progress; family member waiting at staging
